messages:
devon: FYI CI linkcheck blew up after the slugify bump merged last night. failing anchors on /guides/migrate and /sdk/python/examples maria: on it. saw the linkcheck report in CI — which commit/PR is that? devon: PR #2345 (slugify v2). linkcheck output shows 404 for these fragments: /guides/migrate#runtime-config and /sdk/python/examples#code-sample-embed kevin: likely the soft-hyphen/zwj normalization change. i ran `git show --name-only origin/main~1..origin/main` and the headers look subtly different (different U+2011 vs U+002D). had a similar emoji-anchor hit earlier. olga: quick options: 1) add explicit MDX header ids (e.g., `### Runtime config {#runtime-config}`), 2) insert raw HTML id `

Runtime config

` for the affected pages, or 3) add linkcheck exceptions. maria: i prefer MDX explicit ids to keep source consistent. i'll draft a tiny PR that patches the two pages and adds a test case to the linkcheck suite so we don't regress. devon: SG. note we have both Docusaurus and MkDocs dirs — make sure the fix lives in both places if the content is duplicated. kevin: heads-up: some examples embed page anchors in code blocks (e.g., `http://docs/redwood/guides/migrate#runtime-config`) — those literal links can break too if the slug changes. we should either update the example links or use path-only links and rely on stable explicit ids. maria: opening patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2768. changes: add `{#runtime-config}` to guides/migrate.md and `{#code-sample-embed}` to sdk/python/examples.md, plus linkcheck fixtures. linkcheck-bot: Linkcheck job started for PR #2768 linkcheck-bot: FAILURE: 2 broken fragments found: - /guides/migrate#runtime-config -> 404 (anchor not present) - /sdk/python/examples#code-sample-embed -> 404 (anchor not present) (devon posted a short failure log): ``` LinkChecker: Scanning site... ERROR: /guides/migrate -> fragment '#runtime-config' not found in /guides/migrate/index.html ERROR: /sdk/python/examples -> fragment '#code-sample-embed' not found in /sdk/python/examples/index.html Build aborted with exit code 2 ``` maria: Hmm CI still red — my commit added ids but looks like they didn't make it into the built HTML. maybe the MDX preprocessor is stripping explicit IDs before the slug plugin runs. kevin: ah — order matters. slugify plugin is running after MDX remark-id insertion in our pipeline. if the slug plugin normalizes differently it will rewrite ids. two approaches: 1) move the remark-id step later in the pipeline, or 2) add a small post-processing step to normalize anchors to the slugify output. olga: option 2 is less invasive for now. i can write a small node script to scan generated HTML and inject legacy id aliases for two weeks. quick prototype: ``` // scripts/inject-legacy-anchors.js (sketch) const cheerio = require('cheerio'); // for each file, map legacy -> canonical and insert before h2 ``` maria: deploy-bot, can you build a preview for my PR so i can inspect the generated HTML? deploy-bot: preview build created: https://deploy-preview-2768--redwood-docs.netlify.app (takes ~30s to index) maria: confirmed — generated HTML h2 ids are using nonbreaking hyphen variant. my explicit `{#runtime-config}` was rewritten to `runtime‑config` (U+2011). linkcheck expects ASCII hyphen. devon: OK two-step plan: olga protos the injector and we enable it only on the preview pipeline for the immediate fix. kevin/eng infra to follow with a longer term pipeline ordering change. also add linkcheck exceptions for these two fragments for 14 days. kevin: i'll file an infra ticket to change the processor order and add tests: INFRA-1294. olga: pushed prototype in `scripts/anchor-alias-injector.js` and added it to preview pipeline config on my branch. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2768 (now includes injector run for preview builds). linkcheck-bot: Rerun linkcheck on preview (with injector) -> PASS maria: nice. i'll merge the explicit-id + injector PR and then open a follow-up to remove injector once INFRA-1294 lands. devon: thanks team. follow-ups: - add note to the migration guide about slugifier change and anchors - audit top 20 doc pages for literal fragment links - set a 2-week reminder to remove linkcheck exceptions kevin: i'll handle the top-20 audit, starting with pages that have historically heavy linking. maria: merging now since preview is green. tagging @eng-runtime for awareness about any runtime docs that reference anchors. :shipit: devon: thanks all :thumbsup:
